snippet.title: Kettle Street Game Trailer October
snippet.description:
A little British town to call your own. Drive the number 12, pull pints at the local and turn your first flat into a proper home.

Meet Kettle Street, a cosy British life sim where you do the jobs yourself, get to know the neighbours and build a life one wage packet at a time.

Play on iPhone, iPad and Android:
https://kettlestreet.co.uk/get

Try your first in-game week free, then unlock the full game with one purchase. No adverts, subscriptions or energy timers.

Put the kettle on. You’re home.

#KettleStreet #CosyGames #LifeSim
